This is third application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Surksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.58/2023 registered at Police Station- Mahila Thana, District-Seoni (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 294, 376(2)(n), 506 of the IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 09.12.2023.
He is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix is major.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on bail.

3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State as NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:50690 2 MCRC-39914-2024 well as counsel appearing for the Objector opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted by counsel appearing for the Objector that repeated threats are being given to prosecutrix to compromise the case.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be released on bail.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and fact that applicant is in jail since 09.12.2023, prosecutrix has been examined and now there is no chance that applicant will be able to influence the witnesses or tamper with the evidence of the case
, bail application filed by applicant, is allowed on condition that applicant or his relative will not approach the prosecutrix or her family members in any way.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
